blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Handcrafted preprocessing is widely employed in automated dermoscopic analysis to suppress imaging artifacts and enhance lesion visibility. Nevertheless, its actual contribution to modern real-time models remains unclear, particularly when evaluation protocols do not adequately control correlations among images of the same lesion. This study presents a leakage-controlled, lesion-disjoint evaluation of dermoscopic preprocessing and augmentation for joint multi-class lesion classification and instance segmentation using a fixed nano-scale YOLO26 segmentation model (YOLO26n-seg). From HAM10000 (10,015 images), quality control yields 10,013 valid image–mask pairs from 7,468 unique lesions, partitioned into mutually exclusive sets by lesion identity. With the architecture, resolution, training budget, and evaluation protocol held fixed, we compare minimally processed images plus online augmentation against offline class balancing, DullRazor–CLAHE preprocessing, and raw–processed hybrid views, over three random seeds. On the lesion-disjoint test set, the raw baseline achieves a mask mAP 50:95 of 0.5636 ± 0.0234 0.5636\pm 0.0234 , a Dice score of 0.9356 ± 0.0024 0.9356\pm 0.0024 , and a macro-F1 score of 0.6917 ± 0.0202 0.6917\pm 0.0202 . Offline augmentation does not improve the mean performance, while the combined and hybrid strategies reduce both class-aware segmentation and classification accuracy. At only 2.69 million parameters, the model runs at approximately 50 frames per second. Under a leakage-controlled, lesion-disjoint protocol with all non-input factors held fixed, minimally processed dermoscopic images combined with standard online augmentation deliver a better accuracy–efficiency trade-off than increasingly complex deterministic preprocessing, which yields no consistent joint benefit across three seeds on HAM10000.
blocks.zh: 手工预处理被广泛用于自动皮肤分析,以抑制成像文物并增强损伤能见度。 尽管如此,它对现代实时模型的实际贡献仍然不明确,特别是在评价协议不能充分控制同一种损伤的图像之间的相关性时。 本研究采用固定纳米尺度的YOLO26分化模型(YOLO26n-seg),对皮肤预处理和增强进行渗出控制、损伤-分解评价,以便进行多类联合损伤分类和实例分解。 从HAM1000(10,015个图像)中,质量控制从7,468个独特的损伤中得出了10,013个有效图像-面具对,通过损伤身份被分割成相互排斥的组合。 随着架构、分辨率、培训预算和评估协议的固定,我们将最小处理的图像加上在线增强与离线类平衡、DullRazor-CLAHE预处理和原始处理的混合视图比作三个随机种子。 在损伤-脱节试验集上,生平基线实现口罩mAP 50:95 ± 0.0536 ± 0.0234 0.5636\pm 0.0234 地德分为 0.9356 ± 0.0024 0.9356\pm 0.0024 地德分为 0.6917 ± 0.0202 0.6917\pm 0.0202 地德分为 . 离线增强不会改善平均性能,而结合和混合战略既会降低班级认知分化,也会降低分类精度. 该模型仅以269万个参数运行,每秒运行约50帧. 根据一种控制渗漏的、损伤-脱节的协议,所有非输入因素都持有固定的、经过最小处理的皮肤成像,加上标准的在线增强,比日益复杂的确定性预处理更能实现准确性-效率取舍,在HAM10000上,3个种子没有获得一致的共同利益。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Skin lesion assessment relies strongly on visual characteristics such as color, texture, shape, and border structure. Dermoscopy provides non-invasive visualization of subsurface features and improves melanoma diagnostic accuracy over unaided examination [ 1 ] , yet interpretation remains challenging because different lesion categories may appear similar while lesions within a category vary considerably. Deep neural networks have therefore emerged as decision-support tools that learn discriminative representations directly from dermoscopic images [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 皮肤损伤评估强烈地依赖于视觉特征,如颜色,纹理,外形和边框结构等. 皮肤镜检查为地表下特征提供了非侵入可视性,比无辅助检查改进了黑色素瘤诊断精度[1],但解释仍然具有挑战性,因为不同的损伤类别可能看起来相似,而某一类别内的损伤差异很大。 因此,深层神经网络已成为直接从皮肤图像中学习歧视性表述的决策支持工具[2]。

blocks.en: Automated dermoscopic analysis commonly involves lesion segmentation and classification. Segmentation delineates abnormal tissue, whereas classification assigns the lesion to a diagnostic category. Research on both tasks has been accelerated by public challenges organized by the International Skin Imaging Collaboration (ISIC) [ 3 ] . The Human Against Machine with 10,000 training images (HAM10000) dataset is a widely used benchmark comprising 10,015 dermoscopic images from seven diagnostic categories [ 4 ] . Because multiple images may represent the same lesion under different acquisition conditions, random image-level partitioning can place correlated observations in separate subsets and yield optimistic estimates of generalization. Lesion-level separation is therefore important for reliable medical machine-learning evaluation [ 5 ] .
blocks.zh: 自动皮肤分析通常涉及损伤分解和分类。 分解划定了异常组织,而分解则将损伤归入诊断类别。 国际皮肤成像合作组织组织的公众挑战加速了这两项任务的研究。 " 人类对抗机器 " 有10 000个训练图像(HAM1000)数据集是一个广泛使用的基准,由来自7个诊断类别的10 015个皮肤图像组成。 由于多个图像在不同获取条件下可能代表同一种损伤,随机的图像平分可以将相關的观测放入单独的子集并产生乐观的概括估计. 因此,Lesion级分离对于可靠的医疗机器学习评价十分重要[5].

blocks.en: Dermoscopic images may contain hairs, uneven illumination, low contrast, and acquisition artifacts. Common preprocessing techniques include DullRazor hair removal [ 6 ] , contrast-limited adaptive histogram equalization (CLAHE) [ 7 ] , Gray World color normalization [ 8 ] , and lesion-centered region-of-interest (ROI) extraction. Although visually motivated, these transformations may alter diagnostically relevant information or introduce artificial patterns. Consistent with this concern, Mahbod et al. found that segmentation-based image manipulation did not consistently improve dermoscopic classification and that removing surrounding context could reduce performance [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 外观图像可能包含有毛发、不均匀的发光、低对比和获得的文物。 常见的预处理技术包括 DullRazor 头发去除 [6],相差有限的适应直方图平分(CLAHE) [7], Gray 世界色彩正常化[8],和以损伤为中心的利益区取出. 这些转变虽然有视觉动机,但可能改变诊断相关信息或引入人工模式。 与这种关切一致的是,Mahbod等人认为,基于分解的图像操纵没有一贯地改进皮肤分解分类,去除周围环境会降低性能[9].

blocks.en: Data augmentation raises a related concern. Online augmentation applies stochastic transformations during training, whereas offline augmentation explicitly creates additional samples that can target minority classes but remain correlated with their sources and must be restricted to the training set [ 10 ] . Distinguishing the two is essential to avoid confounding preprocessing, sampling, and augmentation effects.
blocks.zh: 数据扩充提出了相关的关切。 网上扩能在培训期间采用有条理的转变,而离线扩能则明确创造更多的样本,这些样本可以针对少数群体的班级,但仍与其来源相关,必须限于培训[10]。 区分这两者对于避免混淆预处理、取样和增强效应至关重要。

blocks.en: Classification and segmentation are often studied separately, although both objectives can be learned from shared dermoscopic representations [ 11 ] . Their performance is not interchangeable: accurate lesion overlap does not guarantee correct diagnosis, and correct classification may accompany an incomplete boundary. A joint system should therefore be assessed using both spatial and class-aware metrics [ 12 , 13 ] . The YOLO family provides an efficient foundation for this setting by combining localization and class prediction within a unified framework [ 14 ] , and its recent extensions add instance segmentation while preserving practical inference speed. In particular, the nano-scale YOLO26 segmentation variant (YOLO26n-seg) jointly predicts lesion location, diagnostic class, confidence, and a pixel-level mask [ 15 ] . Comparisons among recent YOLO generations further demonstrate that architecture and model scale affect accuracy–latency trade-offs, emphasizing the need for matched experimental conditions [ 16 , 17 ] .
blocks.zh: 分类和分门别类常常单独研究,虽然两个目标都可从共同的外观表述中学习[11]. 它们的性能不能被互换:准确的损伤重叠并不能保证正确的诊断,正确的分类可能伴随着不完整的边界. 因此,应同时使用空间和有分级意识的度量标准[12、13]评估联合系统。 YOLO家族通过将本地化和类预测结合到一个统一的框架中[14],为这种设置提供了高效的基础,其最近的扩展增加了实例分解,同时保持了实用的推论速度. 尤其是纳米尺度的YOLO26分化变体(YOLO26n-seg)共同预测损伤位置,诊断等级,置信度,和像素级口罩[15]. 近代YOLO的比较进一步表明,建筑和模型尺度会影响准确性-相对的取舍,强调需要匹配的实验条件[16,17].

blocks.en: Despite these advances, the benefit of dermoscopic preprocessing remains unclear because previous evaluations often vary data partitioning, architecture, resolution, augmentation, sampling, and prediction policies simultaneously. It is therefore necessary to determine whether increasingly complex preprocessing provides a genuine advantage under leakage-controlled and otherwise matched conditions.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但皮肤预处理的益处仍不清楚,因为以前的评价往往在数据分割、结构、分辨率、增强、取样和预测政策同时出现差异。 因此,有必要确定,在渗漏控制条件下或以其他方式匹配的条件下,日益复杂的预处理是否提供了真正的优势。

blocks.en: This study evaluates handcrafted dermoscopic preprocessing for lightweight joint multi-class lesion classification and instance segmentation under a lesion-disjoint protocol. Using a fixed YOLO26n-seg architecture, we compare minimally processed images, offline class-balancing augmentation, DullRazor–CLAHE preprocessing, individual preprocessing components, ROI transformations, and hybrid raw–processed training views, evaluating the principal configurations across three random seeds.
blocks.zh: 本研究评估了轻量级联合多级损伤分类和例分化的手动皮肤预处理。 使用一个固定的YOLO26n-seg架构,我们比较了最小处理的图像,离线类平衡增强,DullRazor-CLAHE预处理,单个预处理组件,ROI变换,以及混合原始处理的训练视图,评价了三个随机种子的主要配置.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this study are as follows:
blocks.zh: 这项研究的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: • Leakage-controlled evaluation: We show that the pre-existing image-level split leaks 765 lesions (of 7,468) across subsets, and we construct a SHA-256–frozen, lesion-disjoint partition with zero cross-subset overlap. • Controlled preprocessing analysis: Holding the architecture, resolution, training budget, thresholds, and evaluation procedure fixed, we isolate preprocessing and augmentation as the only varied factors across four principal configurations and seven component ablations. • Finding and reproducible baseline: Over three seeds we jointly report classification, class-aware segmentation, boundary quality, model size, and speed, and we show that minimally processed inputs with online augmentation give the best accuracy–efficiency trade-off, establishing a reproducible lightweight baseline (2.69 M parameters, approximately 50 FPS).
blocks.zh: • 泄漏控制评价: 我们显示,先前存在的图像平面分裂在子集中漏出765个损伤(7,468个),我们构建了一个SHA-256-被冻结的,损伤-分解的分区,零相接子集重叠. • 控制前处理分析: 将结构、分辨率、培训预算、阈值和评价程序固定下来,我们将预处理和扩增作为四个主要组合和七个部分的唯一不同因素。 二. 支助 寻找和可复制的基准: 超过3个种子,我们共同报告分类、分级、边界质量、模型大小和速度,我们显示,通过在线增强处理的最小投入提供了最佳的准确性-效率取舍,建立了可复制的轻量级基线(2.69M参数,约50个FPS ) 。

blocks.en: Leakage-controlled evaluation: We show that the pre-existing image-level split leaks 765 lesions (of 7,468) across subsets, and we construct a SHA-256–frozen, lesion-disjoint partition with zero cross-subset overlap.
blocks.zh: 泄漏控制评价: 我们显示,先前存在的图像平面分裂在子集中漏出765个损伤(7,468个),我们构建了一个SHA-256-被冻结的,损伤-分解的分区,零相接子集重叠.

blocks.en: Controlled preprocessing analysis: Holding the architecture, resolution, training budget, thresholds, and evaluation procedure fixed, we isolate preprocessing and augmentation as the only varied factors across four principal configurations and seven component ablations.
blocks.zh: 控制预处理分析: 将结构、分辨率、培训预算、阈值和评价程序固定下来,我们将预处理和扩增作为四个主要组合和七个部分的唯一不同因素。

blocks.en: Finding and reproducible baseline: Over three seeds we jointly report classification, class-aware segmentation, boundary quality, model size, and speed, and we show that minimally processed inputs with online augmentation give the best accuracy–efficiency trade-off, establishing a reproducible lightweight baseline (2.69 M parameters, approximately 50 FPS).
blocks.zh: 寻找和可复制的基准: 超过3个种子,我们共同报告分类、分级、边界质量、模型大小和速度,我们显示,通过在线增强处理的最小投入提供了最佳的准确性-效率取舍,建立了可复制的轻量级基线(2.69M参数,约50个FPS ) 。

blocks.en: The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. Section II presents the dataset preparation, preprocessing configurations, training protocol, and evaluation criteria. Section III reports and discusses the experimental results. Section IV concludes the paper and outlines directions for future research.
blocks.zh: 本文件的其余部分编排如下。 第二节介绍数据集编制、预处理配置、培训协议和评价标准。 第三节报告和讨论实验结果。 第四节总结了该文件并概述了未来研究的方向。

blocks.en: II Methodology
blocks.zh: 二. 方法

blocks.en: II-A Dataset and Annotations
blocks.zh: 数据集和说明

blocks.en: The experimental corpus is constructed by matching HAM10000 metadata, dermoscopic images, and segmentation masks through image_id . HAM10000 contains 10,015 images from seven classes [ 4 ] : actinic keratoses and intraepithelial carcinoma ( akiec ), basal cell carcinoma ( bcc ), benign keratosis-like lesions ( bkl ), dermatofibroma ( df ), melanoma ( mel ), melanocytic nevi ( nv ), and vascular lesions ( vasc ). Corresponding publicly released ISIC segmentation masks, which serve as the segmentation ground truth, are matched by image identifier [ 3 ] .
blocks.zh: 实验体是通过匹配HAM1000元数据、皮肤图像和通过图像_id的分块口罩来构建的。 HAM1000包含来自7个类的10,015个图像[4]:活性白喉和肠内癌(akiec),玄武细胞癌(bcc),良性白喉病类损伤(bkl),去马托菲布罗玛(df),黑色素瘤(mel),黑色素nevi(nv)和血管损伤(vasc). 相应的公开发布的国际标准行业分类分块口罩作为分块地面真理,相匹配的有图像标识符 [3].

blocks.en: Quality control excludes two uniformly foreground masks, ISIC_0026042 and ISIC_0029819 , because they do not delineate lesion boundaries. The final corpus therefore contains 10,013 valid image–mask pairs from 7,468 lesions, distributed as shown in Table I .
blocks.zh: 质量控制不包括两个统一的前台口罩,即ISIC_0026042和ISIC_0029819,因为它们没有划定损伤界限。 因此,最终体包括10 013个有效图像-面具对,分布于表一。

blocks.en: Table I : Class distribution of the lesion-disjoint dataset.
blocks.zh: 表一:疾病-脱节数据集的分类分布。

blocks.en: Each binary mask is converted into a class-aware YOLO polygon from its largest valid external contour and simplified using the Douglas–Peucker algorithm [ 18 ] . The audit verifies image and mask readability, polygon validity, label completeness, and consistency with diagnostic metadata.
blocks.zh: 每个二进制口罩从最大有效外观被转换为有分级意识的YOLO多边形并使用道格拉斯-佩克算法[18]被简化. 审计验证了图像和遮罩的可读性,多边形有效性,标签完整性,以及与诊断元数据的一致性.

blocks.en: II-B Lesion-Disjoint Split and Leakage Audit
blocks.zh: II-B 联合拆分和泄漏审计

blocks.en: HAM10000 contains multiple images of some lesions; consequently, image-level splitting can place correlated observations in different subsets and overestimate generalization [ 5 ] . Indeed, the pre-existing image-level split contains 765 lesions spanning more than one subset.
blocks.zh: HAM1000包含多幅一些损伤的图像;因此,图像平分可以将相關的观测放入不同的子集并高估通訊 [5]. 事实上,先前存在的图像平分包含765起伤害,涉及不止一个子集。

blocks.en: We therefore group samples by lesion_id and generate an approximately class-stratified 70%/15%/15% split using seed 42. The training, validation, and test sets contain 7,006, 1,504, and 1,503 images from 5,231, 1,117, and 1,120 lesions, respectively. All classes are represented in each subset, with zero lesion overlap. The assignments and file provenance are frozen in a manifest whose split-defining contents are recorded using a 256-bit Secure Hash Algorithm (SHA-256) digest.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们用病原体进行分类,利用42个种子产生约70%/15%/15%的分化。 培训、鉴定和试验装置分别载有5 231 1 117和1 120个损伤的7 006个、1 504个和1 503个图像。 所有类别都出现在每个子集中,零损伤重叠. 任务和文件出处被冻结在一份清单中,该清单使用256-bit Security Hash Algorithm(SHA-256)文摘记录其分解内容。

blocks.en: Region-of-interest (ROI) extraction uses the bounding rectangle of the largest contour. A crop is accepted only if it covers at least 50% of the image and preserves all foreground pixels; accepted crops receive a 2% margin.
blocks.zh: 利益区(ROI)取出使用最大轮廓的相接矩. 只有覆盖了至少50%的图像并保存了所有前景像素的作物才会被接受;接受的作物得到2%的边距.

blocks.en: Offline augmentation jointly transforms images and masks using flips, affine and color transformations, and Gaussian blur. Three variants are generated for each non- nv training image using preparation seed 42; no offline variant is introduced into validation or test data.
blocks.zh: 离线增强联合将图像和口罩通过翻转,取芬和色变来进行转换,高斯模糊. 每个非nv训练图像使用制备种子42生成出三种变体;没有将离线变体引入验证或测试数据.

blocks.en: II-D YOLO26 Joint Classification and Instance Segmentation
blocks.zh: II-D YOLO26 联合分类和实例分类

blocks.en: YOLO26n-seg is initialized from yolo26n-seg.pt and fine-tuned for the seven lesion classes [ 15 ] . Each predicted instance contains a box, confidence, class, and mask, enabling lesion classification and instance segmentation in one inference pass.
blocks.zh: YOLO26n-seg从yolo26n-seg.pt被初始化并被精细地调整为7个损伤类[15]. 每个预测实例都包含一个盒子、信心、类和口罩,使损伤分类和实例分出在一个推断口中。

blocks.en: Because each image contains one primary lesion, only the single highest-confidence instance is retained for per-image evaluation, and each ground-truth mask is reduced to its largest external contour, so both masks are single-lesion by construction. A missing detection produces an explicit no_detection classification outcome and an empty predicted mask, ensuring that detection failures remain in both task evaluations.
blocks.zh: 因为每个图像都包含有1个主发损伤,所以每个图像评价只保留一个最有自信的例子,每个地真口罩被缩小到最大的外相,所以两个口罩都是由构造而成的单发. 一个缺失的检测产生一个明确的No_检测分类结果和一个空的预测口罩,确保检测失败在两个任务评价中都保留.

blocks.en: YOLO26n-seg is fixed across the principal preprocessing strategies. YOLO11n-seg and YOLO12n-seg serve as raw-input architecture controls, while YOLO26s-seg assesses the effect of increased capacity.
blocks.zh: YOLO26n-seg被固定在主预处理策略上. YOLO11n-seg和YOLO12n-seg作为原始输入架构控制,而YOLO26s-seg则评估了容量增加的影响.

blocks.en: II-E Training Protocol
blocks.zh: 二-E 培训议定书

blocks.en: Except for the deterministic no-augmentation control, all principal configurations use the same 640 × 640 640\times 640 resolution, training budget, optimizer, and online augmentation policy. Training lasts up to 300 epochs with batch size 16. AdamW [ 20 ] uses an initial learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} , weight decay of 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} , three warm-up epochs, and cosine decay [ 21 ] . Early stopping uses a patience of 50 epochs, and the checkpoint with the best validation fitness is retained.
blocks.zh: 除定型无增强控制外,所有主配置都采用相同的640×640640\times 640分辨率,培训预算,优化器,在线增强政策. 培训时间可达300个世纪,分批16个。 AdamW [20] 使用初始学习率为10−3 10−-3},体重衰减为5×10−4 5\times 10−4},三个热化纪元,和余弦衰减[21]. 早期停站使用50个纪元的耐用性,并保留最有验证能力的检查站.

blocks.en: Online augmentation includes hue–saturation–value perturbation, rotations within ± 30 ∘ \pm 30^{\circ} , 10% translation, 30% scaling, horizontal and vertical flips, and mosaic augmentation [ 22 ] ; mosaic is disabled during the final ten epochs. A deterministic raw-image control disables all stochastic online augmentation.
blocks.zh: 在线增强包括hue-s饱和-值扰动,在±30 \\\pm 30\\\\Circ}内旋转,翻译10%,缩放30%,水平和垂直翻转,以及镶嵌增强 [22];镶嵌在最后的十个世纪被禁用. 决定性的原始图像控制可以禁用所有有花样的在线增强。

blocks.en: Principal configurations are trained with seeds 42, 52, and 62 and component ablations with seed 42; validation data guide checkpoint selection, and test data are used only for final evaluation.
blocks.zh: 主要配置训练有种子42,52和62并配有种子42的组分;验证数据指导检查点选择,测试数据仅用于最终评价.

blocks.en: III Numerical Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 三. 数字结果和讨论

blocks.en: All results are obtained on the lesion-disjoint test set. Principal configurations are reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation over the three seeds, and component ablations use seed 42.
blocks.zh: 所有结果均取自损伤-脱节测试集. 主要布局报告为3个种子的平均值±\pm标准偏差,而组件冲洗则使用42个种子.

blocks.en: III-A Main Preprocessing and Augmentation Comparison
blocks.zh: 三-A 主要预处理和增强比较

blocks.en: Table III : Three-seed test performance of the main YOLO26n-seg configurations. Acc., BAcc., and BF 1 denote accuracy, balanced accuracy, and boundary F 1 score, respectively; bold values indicate the best mean.
blocks.zh: 表 三:主YOLO26n-seg配置的三种子测试性能. Acc., BAcc., BF 1分别表示精度,平衡精度和边界F 1分;粗体值表示最优平分.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Main test-set comparison of the four principal input strategies and the deterministic no-augmentation control. Points denote three-seed means, horizontal error bars denote standard deviations, and dashed lines mark the raw baseline (raw + online augmentation).
blocks.zh: 图2:四大输入策略与定型无增量控制的主要测试集比较. 点表示三种子手段,水平出错栏表示标准偏差,虚线标出原始基线(raw + 在线增强).

blocks.en: As shown in Table III and summarized in Fig. 2 , the raw baseline (raw + online augmentation) achieves the strongest overall performance, including the highest accuracy, balanced accuracy, macro-F1, boundary F1, and mask mAP. Removing online augmentation causes the largest decline, reducing macro-F1 from 0.6917 0.6917 to 0.5893 0.5893 and mask mAP 50 : 95 \mathrm{mAP}_{50:95} from 0.5636 0.5636 to 0.4271 0.4271 , confirming that the “less is more” finding concerns deterministic preprocessing rather than augmentation itself. DullRazor–CLAHE reduces both classification and class-aware segmentation performance, whereas the hybrid strategy attains the best binary overlap (Dice 0.9366 0.9366 , IoU 0.8978 0.8978 ) but lower balanced accuracy, macro-F1, and mask mAP, reinforcing that overlap quality and diagnostic recognition are not interchangeable. Given the three-seed standard deviations, offline class balancing and the hybrid stay within one standard deviation of the baseline on the class-aware metrics, so the added complexity yields no measurable joint benefit; differences among the principal configurations are interpreted descriptively rather than as significant. All configurations share the same 2.69 M-parameter model, and the raw baseline gives the best accuracy–efficiency balance.
blocks.zh: 如表三和图2所概述,原始基线(raw + 在线增强)实现最强的整体性能,包括最高准确度,均衡准确度,宏-F1,边界F1和口罩mAP. 消除网上增加原因 最大幅度的下降,将宏F1从0.6917 0.6917降至0.5893 0.5893和口罩mAP 50 : 95\mathrm{mAP}_{50:95}从0.5636 0.5636降至0.4271 0.4271,证实“较小的”发现涉及确定性预处理,而不是增强本身。 DullRazor – CLAHE 既降低了分类性能,也降低了类感分化性能,而混合策略则实现了最好的二进制重合(Dice 0.9366 0.9366,IoU 0.8978 0.8978),但平衡性更低,宏-F1和口罩mAP,强化了这种重合质量和诊断识别是不能互换的. 考虑到三种子标准偏差,离线类平衡和混合型停留在类知度量基准的一个标准偏差内,因此增加的复杂性不会产生可衡量的联合效益;主要配置之间的差异被解释为描述性而非重大. 所有配置都使用相同的2.69M参数模型,而原始基线给出了最佳的精确-效率平衡.

blocks.en: III-B Component Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 三-B 组成部分关联研究

blocks.en: Table IV : Component ablation on the lesion-disjoint test set using seed 42. The raw reference is the single-seed counterpart of the three-seed raw baseline in Table III . Bold values indicate the best result in each column.
blocks.zh: 表四:利用42个种子对损伤-脱节试验集进行成份膨胀。 原始参考是表三中三种子原始基线的单种对应物。 粗体值表示每栏的最佳结果。

blocks.en: Table IV shows that ROI extraction produces the highest balanced accuracy, macro-F1, and mask mAP, whereas Gray World achieves the best Dice, IoU, and boundary F1. CLAHE slightly improves mask mAP over the matched raw reference but reduces accuracy and macro-F1, while DullRazor consistently weakens the main metrics. Combining ROI with DullRazor and either CLAHE or Gray World produces no additive benefit and generally performs below the raw reference, indicating that successive transformations may alter useful color, texture, or boundary cues. Since these ablations use a single seed, their differences are interpreted directionally: individual operations such as ROI extraction may lead several isolated metrics, yet these gains do not survive composition and are not reproduced as three-seed principal configurations. The seed-averaged evidence in Table III therefore governs the conclusion that increasingly complex preprocessing does not provide a consistent joint classification–segmentation advantage.
blocks.zh: 表四显示ROI萃取出最均衡的精度,宏-F1和口罩mAP,而Gray World则实现了最佳的Dice,IoU和边界F1. CLAHE比相匹配的原始引用略微改进了口罩mAP,但降低了精度和宏-F1,而DullRazor则始终弱化了主度量. 将ROI与 DullRazor 和 CLAHE 或 Gray World 合并,不会产生添加剂的好处,一般在原始参考书下进行,表明相继的转变可能会改变有用的颜色,纹理或边界提示. 由于这些活化利用了单一的种子,它们的区别被从方向上解释:像ROI提取这样的单个操作可能导出若干个孤立的度量衡,然而这些增益在组成上无法幸存并被复制为三种子主构型. 因此,表三中的种子平均证据决定了以下结论,即日益复杂的预处理不能提供一致的联合分类-分类优势。

blocks.zh: 三-C 结构和效率分析

blocks.en: Among the nano-scale models, YOLO12n-seg achieves the highest mean macro-F1 ( 0.6962 0.6962 ) and mask mAP 50 : 95 \mathrm{mAP}_{50:95} ( 0.5758 0.5758 ), whereas YOLO26n-seg uses the fewest parameters (2.69 M). YOLO12n-seg attains a measured throughput of 54.33 ± 21.76 54.33\pm 21.76 FPS, but the large run-to-run variation, which reflects system contention on a single shared GPU, together with the separately executed benchmarks, makes latency rankings descriptive. YOLO26s-seg further improves the seed-42 scores but requires 3.85 times as many parameters and a checkpoint 3.55 times as large as YOLO26n-seg. Overall, YOLO12n-seg and YOLO26n-seg are statistically indistinguishable on the accuracy metrics across three seeds (overlapping standard deviations), with YOLO26n-seg the most parameter-efficient; this equivalence does not alter the preprocessing comparison, for which YOLO26n-seg is fixed across all strategies.
blocks.zh: 在纳米尺度模型中,YOLO12n-seg实现最高的平均值宏-F1(0.6962 0.6962)和口罩mAP 50:95\mathrm{mAP}_{50:95}(0.5758 0.5758),而YOLO26n-seg使用最少的参数(2.69 M). YOLO12n-seg的测得通量为54.33±21.76 54.33\pm 21.76 FPS,但大的跑入跑变异,反映了系统对单个共享GPU的争论,加上单独执行的基准,使得延迟排名成为描述. YOLO26s-seg进一步提高了"种子-42"的分数,但需要3.85倍的参数和3.55倍于"YOLO26n-seg"的检查站. 总体而言,YOLO12n-seg和YOLO26n-seg在统计上无法区分出三个种子的精度度度量(重叠标准偏差),而YOLO26n-seg是参数效率最高的;这种等同性并不改变预处理比较,对此,YOLO26n-seg在所有策略中都是固定的.

blocks.en: III-D Per-Class and Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 每类和定性分析

blocks.en:
For the raw baseline, the mean per-class F1 scores over three seeds are 0.9127 0.9127 for nv , 0.8008 0.8008 for vasc , 0.7449 0.7449 for bcc , 0.7238 0.7238 for df , 0.6971 0.6971 for bkl , 0.5423 0.5423 for mel , and 0.4204 0.4204 for akiec . The low akiec F1 is primarily associated with a recall of 0.2789 0.2789 despite a precision of 0.8585 0.8585 , meaning that most akiec lesions are missed and assigned to other classes; this is a safety-relevant limitation for a pre-malignant category, driven by its low support and overlap with bkl . The confusion matrices further show that the dominant melanoma error is mel → \rightarrow nv (melanoma predicted as benign nevus), the most safety-critical failure mode, together with akiec → \rightarrow bkl confusion, consistent with class imbalance and overlapping dermoscopic appearance.
Fig. 3 illustrates this task dependence: the model accurately delineates representative mel and nv lesions, but some highly overlapping masks are assigned to the wrong diagnostic class. In particular, Dice scores of 0.991 0.991 and 0.936 0.936 accompany mel → \rightarrow nv and nv → \rightarrow bkl errors, respectively, confirming that geometric agreement alone is insufficient for evaluating joint lesion analysis and that a segmentation-only score would conceal these diagnostic errors.

blocks.en: III-E Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 三-E 讨论和限制

blocks.en: The results favor minimally processed dermoscopic images combined with online augmentation: only online augmentation yields a broad gain, whereas deterministic preprocessing trades isolated overlap improvements for weaker class-aware recognition. Thus, “less is more” refers to limiting deterministic preprocessing rather than removing augmentation. These results characterize a research baseline for method comparison and do not establish diagnostic or triage utility; the high Dice partly reflects the single-lesion, lesion-filling geometry of HAM10000 rather than clinically difficult boundary cases. The findings also remain bounded by the HAM10000 acquisition domain, class imbalance, and limited minority-class support. Moreover, three seeds provide limited evidence for small differences, while the ablations and YOLO26s control are directional seed-42 comparisons. The single-lesion prediction policy reflects the dataset structure but not multi-lesion scenes, and the reported throughput excludes image loading and offline preprocessing, representing model execution rather than complete workflow latency.
blocks.zh: 结果有利于最小处理的外观图像与在线增强相结合:只有在线增强才产生广泛收益,而决定性的预处理交易则孤立地进行重叠改进,以降低对类的认识。 因此,“较少的更多”是指限制确定性预处理,而不是去除增强。 这些成果是方法比较的研究基线的特点,没有确定诊断或分辨的效用;高剂量的Dice部分反映了HAM1000的单倍径、多发损伤的几何特征,而不是临床上困难的分界病例。 调查结果还受到HAM1000收购域、阶级不平衡和少数阶级支持有限的限制。 此外,有三种种子对小差异提供的证据有限,而活化和YOLO26s的控制是定向种子-42的比较. 单流预测政策反映了数据集结构而非多流场景,所报道的吞吐量排除了图像加载和下行预处理,代表了模型执行而不是完整的工作流程延时.

blocks.en: IV Concluding Remarks and Open Problems
blocks.zh: 四. 结论和未决问题

blocks.en: This study presented a leakage-controlled, lesion-disjoint evaluation of dermoscopic preprocessing for joint multi-class classification and instance segmentation. Under a fixed YOLO26n-seg with all non-input factors held constant, minimally processed images with online augmentation delivered the strongest overall balance of classification, class-aware segmentation, boundary quality, and efficiency (2.69 M parameters, approximately 50 FPS), whereas increasingly complex deterministic preprocessing produced no consistent joint benefit across three seeds. This does not imply that preprocessing is unhelpful in general: individual operations improved isolated metrics, and cross-device acquisition may shift the balance. The architecture controls showed YOLO12n-seg and YOLO26n-seg to be statistically indistinguishable on accuracy, with YOLO26n-seg the most parameter-efficient. These results establish a reproducible lightweight baseline and emphasize evaluating recognition and segmentation together. Future work should examine cross-dataset and cross-device generalization, improve minority-class recognition, extend evaluation to multi-lesion settings, and investigate adaptive or learnable normalization under the same leakage-controlled protocol.
blocks.zh: 这项研究介绍了对多类联合分类和实例分解的皮肤预处理进行渗出控制、损伤和脱节联合评估。 在固定的YOLO26n-seg中,所有非输入系数保持不变,通过在线增强处理的最小图像在分类、分级、边界质量和效率(2.69M参数,约50个FPS)方面提供了最有力的总体平衡,而日益复杂的确定性预处理没有在三个种子中产生一致的共同利益。 这并不意味着预处理一般是无益的:单个操作改进了孤立的度量衡,而交叉设备的获取可能会转移平衡. 架构控制显示YOLO12n-seg和YOLO26n-seg在统计上对准确性无法区分,而YOLO26n-seg是参数效率最高的. 这些结果确立了可复制的轻量级基线,并强调了共同评价识别和分化。 今后的工作应审查跨数据集和跨设备的通用性,提高少数群体的认知程度,将评价范围扩大到多效应环境,并调查在同一渗漏控制协议下的适应性或可学习的正常化。
